description: Stop a watch: pass your `continuity_handle` and the `watch_id`. Its stored events are deleted; retained receipts stay verifiable. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

continuity_handle.description: The continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; proves you own these watches.

name: gaip_watch_remove
title: Remove a watch
